items.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
items.summary: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.
items.titleZh: 谷歌悄悄更新隐私政策，允许Gmail和照片数据推送广告
items.summaryZh: 10月16日生效的政策变化为谷歌的长期承诺开辟了一个例外——让连接的Gmail、Drive和Photos数据通过其个人智能AI功能个性化广告。

items.title: Zelenskyy says Starlink is working again in Ukraine and thanks Americans who 'took this seriously'
items.summary: Zelenskyy's comments came after a chaotic 10-day period when connection speeds for Starlink were throttled in Ukraine.
items.titleZh: 泽连斯基表示，Starlink正在乌克兰再次开展工作，并感谢“认真对待此事”的美国人
items.summaryZh: 泽连斯基的评论是在乌克兰Starlink的连接速度被限制的混乱的10天之后发表的。

items.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
items.summary: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.
items.titleZh: 瑞典政府办公室屏蔽ChatGPT和Claude，保留微软复制品
items.summaryZh: 瑞典政府办公室将从周一开始在员工电脑上屏蔽ChatGPT和Claude，引导公务员使用微软Copilot作为唯一通过安全审查的人工智能。

items.title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Jeff Bezos’ Blue Origin will face off in orbit next year, NASA confirms. ‘As a rocket nerd, it’s going to be pretty awesome’
items.summary: Administrator Jared Isaacman said Friday that the space agency is still on track to launch Artemis III next summer on a docking exercise with Elon Musk's and Jeff Bezos' lunar landers.
items.titleZh: 美国国家航空航天局证实，埃隆·马斯克的太空探索技术公司和杰夫·贝佐斯的蓝色起源公司将于明年在轨道上对峙。“作为一个火箭迷，这将是非常棒的”
items.summaryZh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼周五表示，该局仍在按计划于明年夏天发射阿尔忒弥斯III号，与埃隆·马斯克和杰夫·贝佐斯的月球着陆器进行对接。

items.title: ‘The transit world is where innovation goes to die’ — The U.S. lags far behind on using driverless trains, but new projects could open the floodgates
items.summary: Washington, D.C., recently advanced a plan that could let computers fully control one of its subways, and Los Angeles is seeking to build a new, completely automated line.
items.titleZh: “交通世界是创新消亡的地方”——美国在使用无人驾驶列车方面远远落后，但新项目可能会打开闸门
items.summaryZh: 华盛顿特区最近提出了一项计划，可以让计算机完全控制其中一条地铁，洛杉矶正在寻求建造一条完全自动化的新线路。

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink and Starshield high speed restrictions have been lifted
items.summary: Ukraine says restrictions on Starlink and Starshield have been lifted, restoring connectivity to fast-moving military systems after disruptions.
